description: Fires only right after the opponent plays in column 6 (right edge), in mid-game (about ply 15-30). Strength depends on how the board is filled: strongest when column 4 holds a moderate number of stones (about 3-5, roughly a fifth of all moves; an empty or completely full column 4 kills it), column 6 is still low (few earlier stones there), and the left columns 0-2 are partly filled. Early-game column-6 moves do not fire.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to its dev max or to zero changes move probabilities by at most about 4 points.
notes: Layer 0. Every firing example has last move col 6. Token-substitution scans: col-4 moves strongly raise it up to ~4 stones then lower it (non-monotone, share-like); earlier col-6 moves lower it; cols 0-2 add slightly; ply ramps it up from ~ply 10. Dev F1: p1 (last=6, ply 15-31, h6<=4) 0.558; weighted counts 0.466-0.628 (best p4 0.628, P 0.49 R 0.87, AUROC 0.92, sim share 0.53); pure col-4 share curve 0.578. Looks like a sequence-composition feature, not a tactical concept; exact strength curve only approximated.
